event_universe: all BTC-5m sample markets with start_sec >= 1788825600 and end_sec <= 1788912000; sort (start_sec, condition_id); one Up token from ordered outcomes and token IDs
decision: scheduled end minus 120 seconds; receive timestamp <= decision; latest raw record first, then validate; no older valid fallback
bbo_validity: finite 0 < bid < ask < 1; same-receive-time conflicting values invalid; no future backfill
snapshot_validity: full book snapshot only; both sides positive price and size, no same-time conflict; not reconstructed deltas
label: binary payout numerator/denominator for index 0 read from Polygon CTF at 0x4D97DCd97eC945f40cF65F87097ACe5EA0476045; require denominator 1 and vector [1,0] or [0,1], match sample token order and outcome metadata; other vectors unknown

splits.assignment: candidate event index before exclusions; boundaries floor fraction times candidate count

B1: common missing markers for snapshot/current state/history

missing: train-segment median imputation with shared indicators in B1/B2/B3; train-only standardization and spline knots; B0 raw midpoint
model: same L2 logistic for B1/B2/B3; C candidates 0.1, 1, 10; train each, select on calibration event log loss; epsilon 1e-6; B1/B2/B3 same paired eligible events
minimum_fit: at least 10 events per class in train and 20 events in scored segment for learned-arm inference; otherwise diagnostic only
primary_comparison: late event-equal B2 minus B1 log loss; B1 minus B0 and B3 minus B2 secondary
boundaries: DEVELOPMENT_PRICING_REPLICATION / WITHIN_DAY_RETROSPECTIVE; no repricing, strategy, fresh final, or actionability claim
